en-US.name: ProxVoice
en-US.summary: Control and monitor your Proxmox cluster with your voice.
en-US.description: ProxVoice lets you ask Alexa for Proxmox node, VM, and LXC status, check performance, and start, stop, shut down, reboot, or reset guests.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Prox Voice for cluster status
Alexa, ask Prox Voice to start docker host

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Use a Proxmox API token configured on the skill endpoint host. Demo mode works without a live cluster.
